fields.title: Clean and merge field survey data from partner sites
fields.problem_statement: Field surveys from 30 partner sites arrive in different spreadsheet layouts and are cleaned and merged by hand; about 3 weeks per wave, 4 waves a year.
fields.current_workflow: Download each site's Excel file from Box, fix the headers to match the template, recode the categorical fields, paste everything into a master sheet.
fields.pain_points: Painful and error prone; 400 duplicate rows found after a report went out; headers vary.
fields.users: Field coordinators and research analysts; about 25 researchers use the merged dataset downstream
fields.volume_or_frequency: 30 sites per wave; 4 waves a year
fields.data_shape: Same question under five different column names; no schema anywhere
fields.what_was_tried: Excel macros a few years ago; asking sites to use the template
fields.why_it_failed: Macros break when sites change their columns; sites did not stick to the template.
fields.constraints: Some sites collect health data; PII must not leave the environment; retention rules apply.
fields.success_criteria: Clean merged dataset within 3 days of the last site submitting; every transformation logged for reviewers; coordinators out of Excel for the merge step.
fields.adoption_risk: Coordinators worried the tool will hide the changes it makes; every recode must be visible and reversible.
fields.security_or_data_use: Health data and PII must stay inside the environment; retention rules apply.
fields.timeline: By next quarter, for the spring wave
fields.open_questions: Whether all 30 sites can share raw files under their agreements.

human_rulings_note: R7 ruled false: five generic latent needs fired; a reviewer judged them boilerplate rather than a specific inferred need for this case.
